exposure: Clinician-initiated delivery (induction of labor or prelabor cesarean)
cohort: 4,295 deliveries at Women & Infants Hospital of Rhode Island from 2002-2013 with gestational hypertension or nonsevere preeclampsia before 39 weeks' gestation
finding: The study predicts that clinician-initiated delivery before 37 weeks' gestation in pregnancies complicated by hypertensive disorders is associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal and infant outcomes compared to expectant management.
